scope: Saved summary, tools, events, messages and public records only. No model/search/simulator/evaluation calls.

definitions.adoption: Exact syntax plus parameter specifications, renamed structure and partial-axis reuse are distinct; structure matches do not prove causality.
definitions.unmatched_rewrite: Algebraically equivalent rewrites not captured by syntax require manual review; never automatically counted as SR adoption.
definitions.validation: Training and all prior SR discovery probes are not independent validation. Candidate rollout checks are discovery diagnostics.
definitions.tokens: User-facing values come directly from summary. API-log verification never invents a full average when usage is missing.
definitions.stages: search_stages records actual backend execution; search_configuration describes plans only.
